description: Main Flutter frontend source file 'main.dart' for the financial tracker system. Contains theme settings, app initialization, authentication flow, and navigation to main screens.

classes.name: FinanceTrackerApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme and initial route.

classes.name: RootSessionGate
classes.description: Determines whether user is authenticated and navigates accordingly.

classes.name: AuthScreen
classes.description: Displays login or registration form based on user interaction.

classes.name: TransactionEditScreen
classes.description: Interface for adding or editing transactions.

classes.name: BudgetEditScreen
classes.description: Interface for adding or editing budgets.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds widget tree for each class requiring UI layout.

methods.name: _isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks SharedPreferences for auth token to verify if user is logged in.

methods.name: _handleLogin
methods.description: Authenticates user via ApiService and stores token on success.

methods.name: toggleAuth
methods.description: Switches between login and register forms.

methods.name: _saveTransaction
methods.description: Saves a new or existing transaction via ApiService.

methods.name: _saveBudget
methods.description: Saves a new or existing budget via ApiService.
